_comment: Core (non-package) Claude hook wiring. Package hooks declare their own fragments under globals/packages/<id>/hooks-claude.json and are merged on enable; these are the hooks roborepo always installs, so they had no fragment and lived only in generated/claude/settings.json — tracked state with no source. scripts/test/core-hook-wiring-check.mjs asserts the two agree.

PreToolUse._comment: Denies pushes that land on a protected branch (main, master, the remote's default), so git push itself can be allowed. See globals/system/hooks/claude/protected-branch-push.mjs.

repo-scope enforcement. Read is included deliberately: reads span the repository family (worktree + primary + siblings) while writes stay bounded to the checkout in use. See globals/harnesses/claude/hooks/repo-write-scope.mjs.
Symlink reminders for writes into managed harness homes. Stays on Write|Edit — it has nothing to say about reads, so widening its matcher would spawn a process per Read for no output.
